tools_history.result: SPECTRA reconstructs 3D geometry from a video by sampling two frames approximately one second apart. It RGB-preprocesses and pads each frame to 518×518, then packs them into the fixed-size FP32 atlas required by VGGT. The VGGT ONNX model produces camera-pose encodings, depth, and depth-confidence maps; the decoder recovers poses and unprojects depth into a filtered point cloud. The pipeline writes a PLY cloud along with reconstruction metadata and a geometry-ready event.
